title: Oswald trained by ONI, part of private field intelligence operation

tellings.quote: actually trained by an office of naval intelligence wasn't CIA and he was in this thing called Operation [ __ ]

plain: Lee Harvey Oswald, the man accused of killing President John F. Kennedy in 1963, was trained not by the CIA but by the Office of Naval Intelligence, the US Navy's spy service, and was part of a privately run intelligence operation in the field, according to a researcher named Dan Sheehan. Sheehan tells this without naming a source, and ties it to figures such as the businessman William D. Pawley, a man named Hunt, the general Charles Willoughby and Guy Banister of New Orleans. If true, it would mean Oswald was working inside a hidden network rather than acting alone.
